mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT userid, nickname, profile_img, grade, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rank FROM users WHERE admin_yn = 0 ) WHERE rank BETWEEN #{startRank} AND #{endRank} AND rank <= 50

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.userid, u.nickname, u.profile_img, u.grade, u.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.score DESC) AS rank FROM users u WHERE u.admin_yn = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_result qr WHERE qr.userid = u.userid AND qr.quiz_type = 'word' ) ) WHERE rank BETWEEN #{startRank} AND #{endRank} AND rank <= 50

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.userid, u.nickname, u.profile_img, u.grade, u.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.score DESC) AS rank FROM users u WHERE u.admin_yn = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_result qr WHERE qr.userid = u.userid AND qr.quiz_type = 'proverb' ) ) WHERE rank BETWEEN #{startRank} AND #{endRank} AND rank <= 50
SELECT USERID AS userId, NICKNAME AS nickname, PROFILE_IMG AS profileImg, GRADE AS grade, SCORE AS score FROM users WHERE USERID = #{userId}
